package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"golang.org/x/mod/semver"
)

//go:wasmexport compare
func compare(a, b int32) int32 {
	return int32(semver.Compare(fmt.Sprintf("v%d.0.0", a), fmt.Sprintf("v%d.0.0", b)))
}

func onlyFromMain() string { return semver.Canonical("v1.2") }

func main() { fmt.Println(onlyFromMain()) }
